text_blocks.content: The ancient trees of Thornreach Grove tower above you, their branches tangled with silver wards that glow faintly in the twilight. You've lived here your whole life, protected by magic older than memory itself. But lately, something has changed. The wards flicker more often, and at night, you hear whispers from beyond their boundary—voices calling from The Veil. Tonight, you've been summoned to the Grove's heart. The circle of druids waits, and their expressions are grave.
